p: sacrifice the passover unto the LORD: You shall eat the Easter lamb.
affliction: Which signified the affliction which you had in Egypt.
not sacrifice the passover within any: This was chiefly accomplished, when the temple was built.
passover at even: Which was instituted to remind them of their deliverance our of Egypt and to encourage them in the hope of Jesus Christ, of whom this lamb was a figure.
number unto thee: Beginning the next morning after the Passover, Le 23:15, Ex 13:4.
observe the feast of tabernacles seven: That is, the 15th day of the seventh month, Le 23:34.
able: According to the ability that God has given him.
Judges and officers shalt thou make: He gave temporary authority to the people to choose magistrates for themselves.
is altogether just shalt thou follow: The magistrate must constantly follow the tenor of the law, and in noting decline from justice.
